description: This bar chart illustrates the relationship between observation probability and average change using compression for inferred frames and other frames. The horizontal axis, labeled “Observation Probability,” displays categories ranging from 0.2 to 0.9 in increments of 0.1, and the bars are arranged in ascending order based on this value. The vertical axis, labeled “Average Change Using Compression,” represents values ranging from -3 to 2, with tick marks at integer values, and appears to be a linear scale.  For each observation probability value, there are three bars representing “Inferred Frames” (dark gray), “Other Frames” (light gray), and a third category (yellow). The “Inferred Frames” bar at 0.2 has a value of approximately -2.3, while at 0.9 it reaches approximately -0.8. The “Other Frames” bar at 0.2 has a value of approximately 0.8, and at 0.9 it reaches approximately 1.2. The yellow bars range from approximately 0.2 at 0.2 observation probability to approximately 1.8 at 0.9 observation probability. No bars are visually emphasized through shading, bolding, outlining, or annotation.
